content.title: What Are My Options If My Business is Insolvent?
content.text: YOUR FREE ASSESSMENT - https://directorfirst.uk/?utm_campaig... WHAT SHOULD UK BUSINESS OWNERS DO WHEN THEIR COMPANY IS STRUGGLING? | Expert Insolvency Advice Not sure what to do when your business is in trouble? In this essential video, Chris Worden from Director First breaks down ALL the options available to UK directors facing tough financial times! Should you fight to save your company, try refinancing, negotiate with creditors – or is it time to close up shop? Chris unpacks each option: Doing Nothing (and why that’s a decision in itself) Informal Agreements with creditors & HMRC The dangers and opportunities in refinance How and when to sell your business Understanding administration and what it means The reality of CVAs (Company Voluntary Arrangements) How to approach Creditors’ Voluntary Liquidation (CVL) Why compulsory liquidation should be avoided With insider tips, real-world warnings, and practical steps, this video is a must-watch for ANY UK business owner or director who’s worried about company debts, creditor pressure, or personal guarantees. Don’t leave your company (or yourself!) at risk. Find out which path is right for you—watch now to get clear, actionable guidance that could save your business, your reputation, and your future.
